title: helianthemum origanifolium f. majus
intro: Helianthemum origanifolium f. majus, commonly known as Rockrose, is a plant species in the family Cistaceae, characterized by its fragrant, white flowers and fragrant, grayish-green foliage. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include calming and sedative effects, as well as its ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum origanifolium f. majus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
